targets.review_note: Let A(s) count cells burned by second s, the area of union of half-open squares of side2s+1 centered at initial cells. Destruction is t*A(t)-sum_{s=0}^{t-1}A(s). As s varies, only edge-order crossings at2s+1=absolute x/y coordinate difference change the union-area polynomial; split integer times at floor(difference/2). Within each block A is quadratic; sum it exactly from up to three values using finite differences. Evaluate union area by x sweep. Active equal-length y intervals have union length w+sum min(adjacent center gap,w); sorted multiset insertion/deletion updates it from neighboring gaps, including duplicate y values. O(n^3 log n) event-bound evaluations for n<=50, independent of huge t. Figure illustrates explicit8-neighbor propagation only.
